correctness.rationale: For two independent killed diffusions started at ordered points, the bad early-exit ordering forces a meeting before the first exit. The strong-Markov path-tail swap injects it into the good ordering for either boundary, giving TP2 inequalities and spatial monotonicity of the log-odds time derivative. Regular Sturm–Liouville flux expansions have simple Dirichlet eigenvalues, a simple second-mode node, and positive K2 by opposite second-mode boundary flux signs. Uniform local C1 expansion gives the unique late root; the third mode at the node and an implicit mean-value estimate give exactly the stated exponential coefficient and little-oh error. The 1,923 standalone finite and grid checks passed; they are not used as infinite proofs.
